name: Self Defense 2
overview: Scripture teaches a balanced view on self-defense, affirming the sanctity of life with the commandment 'Thou shalt not kill' (Exodus 20:13), while also recognizing the right to protect one's property and life. For instance, if a thief is caught breaking in and is killed, no blood guilt is assigned (Exodus 22:2), and David praises the Lord for strength in battle (Psalms 144:1). Jesus' instruction to buy a sword (Luke 22:36) suggests preparedness for defense, yet the principle of measured justice is upheld with the reference to 'an eye for an eye' (Matthew 5:38). Thus, Scripture acknowledges legitimate self-defense within the framework of divine justice and mercy.
